user.title: Leasing contract
user.description: Enter the details of your leasing contract. The odometer entity has to exist in Home Assistant already.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, for example the name of the car.
data_description.start_date: First day of the leasing contract.
data_description.total_km: Mileage included in the contract, in the unit of your odometer entity.
data_description.start_km: Leave at 0 for a new car delivered with an empty odometer. For a used car or a contract taken over, enter the reading on the day the contract started.
data_description.odometer_entity: A sensor, number or input_number holding the current odometer reading.
data_description.forecast_basis: Which average the forecasts and warnings are based on. The windowed averages need recorder history and fall back to the whole contract average when none is available.
